description: Curated landmark extrusions: 73 heritage landmarks (Rattanakosin + Old Town), 27 verified skyline icons (CTBUH + official specs), and 14 hand-curated civic/market/shrine silhouettes (2026-09-26 audit pass restored the valid quarantined entries with corrected Thai names, heights and source citations). Pair with bkk-heritage-detail.geojson for the chedi / ubosot / viharn silhouettes inside the Old Town. Quarantined entries with future-research notes live in bkk-landmarks-quarantine.geojson.
